facts.fact: 这是日志第 43 号（Journal Entry No. 43）。
国家安全局（NSA）位于马里兰州米德堡（Fort Meade, Maryland 20755）；中情局（CIA）创建了自己的大规模国内 AI 监视项目。
facts.anchor: National Security Agency in Fort Meade, Maryland 20755, CIA created her very own stupid-big domestic AI spying program.

facts.fact: 该项目在内部被称为“Operation Kitchen Appliance”。
facts.anchor: known in-house as Operation Kitchen Appliance

facts.fact: 时任中情局局长为 David Petraeus。
涉及的家电包括洗碗机、微波炉、烤面包机、搅拌机和咖啡研磨机。
facts.anchor: dishwashers, microwaves, toaster ovens, blenders, and coffee grinders.

facts.fact: 还涉及“Track F”和国家科学基金会。
facts.anchor: plus “Track F” and the National Science Foundation.

facts.fact: 提到北卡罗来纳州伊丽莎白城的 Edward Snowden。
facts.anchor: Edward Snowden of Elizabeth City, North Carolina,

facts.fact: 该行动具备俄罗斯信息行动的全部典型特征。
facts.anchor: Operation Kitchen Appliance has all the classic earmarks of a Russian information operation.
